title: 自我识别微调可预防并逆转涌现性失调
summary: 研究发现涌现性失调(EM)源于模型对齐角色的破坏，而非直接学习有害内容。自我生成文本识别(SGTR)微调作为一种角色定向干预，在预防和逆转EM方面均有效，且不会恶化任何指标。实验表明EM是模型默认角色的不稳定化，而非采用失调人格。
summary_en: Emergent misalignment (EM) stems from disrupting a model's aligned character, not learning harmful content. Self-generated text recognition (SGTR) finetuning effectively prevents and reverses EM without exacerbating metrics, reframing EM as character destabilization rather than persona adoption.
